annotations.title: Weather forecast: current weather and 48-hour hourly forecast for any city or coordinates

description: Weather for any city or point on Earth (city name, or latitude and longitude): current temperature in Celsius, conditions (clear, cloudy, rain, snow), precipitation in mm, wind, humidity, cloud cover and air pressure, plus an hourly forecast for up to 48 hours. Data from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute; city names resolve via Wikidata. Use for travel and event planning, logistics, agriculture and any agent that needs the weather. Example: city=London. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

city.description: City or place name, e.g. London or Uppsala (used when lat and lon are not given)

hours.description: Hours of hourly forecast to return, 1-48 (default 12; 48 covers tomorrow)

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (with lon, instead of city)

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180 (with lat, instead of city)

name: weather
